verdict.rationale: Spend limits are a fair question for a card-issuing platform like Pomelo, but the evidence pack never documents per-card or per-cardholder amount caps over daily, monthly or all-time windows, nor transaction-count velocity rules. The closest items are adjacent controls: merchant/category/MCC blocking, a 3DS rule that forces a challenge above an amount threshold, and credit-line lifecycle management. None of these is a platform-enforced spend limit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set spend limits per card and per cardholder — amount caps over daily, monthly, or all-time windows, and transaction-count velocity rules — enforced by the platform, not my code
